## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm test` is green (the harness gates every commit)
- [ ] A schema change carries its fixture **and** matching spec prose in this
      same change — fixture-first, per
      [Contributing § Ground rules](../CONTRIBUTING.md#ground-rules)
- [ ] A registry addition keeps ids stable (new slug + alias, never a
      repurposed one)
- [ ] Docs-only or tooling-only change: none of the above apply
